page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.18xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 72 dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 vCPUs running at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 288.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring network-attached storage for persistent data. It does not feature any GPU accelerators. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 33 Gbps.

The ecs.g5ne.18xlarge offers a high-density resource profile suitable for enterprise workloads requiring substantial parallel processing capabilities and balanced memory allocation. It is designed for workloads such as medium-to-large databases, enterprise application hosting, web serving, and general-purpose business applications that benefit from dedicated CPU allocation and high network throughput without the need for local storage or GPU acceleration.
